nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Token decimals, fixed to 18, used as exponent in supply arithmetic.
Total token supply; mutated by constructor, burn, burnFrom and mintToken.
Owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the mintToken authorization check.
Mapping of address to token balance; read and written by every value-transfer path.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom/burnFrom.
Constructor: computes initial supply, credits msg.sender, sets name, symbol and owner.
Public view-style helper (declared payable) returning balanceOf[_owner].
Internal transfer routine performing zero-address, balance and overflow require checks.
Public transfer that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value to _transfer.
Spends an allowance and delegates the actual movement to _transfer.
Writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and returns true.
Approves a spender and then invokes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract.
Destroys _value tokens from the caller and reduces totalSupply.
Destroys tokens from _from using an allowance from msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
Owner-only mint that credits target and totalSupply, then moves tokens via _transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner, owner assignment and authorization check.
initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) unchecked multiplication that can overflow and mint a huge supply.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked arithmetic on solc 0.4.22.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value and totalSupply -= _value unchecked subtractions.
balanceOf[_from], allowance and totalSupply decremented without overflow checks.
balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount and totalSupply += mintedAmount unchecked additions.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) to an untrusted contract.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Debit address of the internal transfer.
Credit address of the internal transfer, must not be 0x0.
Amount moved by the internal transfer.
Recipient of the public transfer call.
Amount of the public transfer call.
Owner of the tokens being spent via allowance.
Recipient in transferFrom.
Amount spent in transferFrom.
Address granted an allowance in approve.
Allowance amount granted in approve.
Spender contract cast to tokenRecipient and called externally.
Allowance amount granted and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the spender callback.
Amount of tokens burned by the caller.
Address whose tokens are burned via allowance.
Amount burned in burnFrom.
Address receiving newly minted tokens.
Amount minted and added to totalSupply.
Base supply multiplied by 10**decimals in the constructor.
Name assigned to the name state variable.
Symbol assigned to the symbol state variable.
Named return value holding the queried balance.
Named return flag of transferFrom, always true on success.
tokenRecipient interface instance wrapping the untrusted _spender address.

edges.reason: initialSupply parameter flows into the unchecked 10**decimals multiplication in the constructor.
decimals state variable is used as the exponent of the supply computation.
The unchecked multiplication result is written to totalSupply.
totalSupply is credited into balanceOf[msg.sender] in the constructor.
msg.sender is the storage key for the balance mapping.
msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping in transferFrom, approve and burnFrom.
balanceOf function reads the balanceOf mapping.
Mapping lookup result is returned through the named local variable balance.
_from selects the balance slot that is decremented without a check.
_value is the unchecked operand of the balance updates.
_to selects the balance slot that is incremented without a check.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates both balanceOf slots involved in the transfer.
_value is applied to the balanceOf mapping.
_to flows from transfer into _transfer.
_value flows from transfer into _transfer.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transfer.
_from of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
_to of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
_value of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
_value is subtracted from the caller allowance without a check.
allowance mapping state feeds the unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction writes the reduced allowance back to storage.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom returns through the named local variable success.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient and called in approveAndCall.
_value is approved and forwarded to the external call.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim to the external spender.
msg.sender is passed into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
_value is passed into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf and totalSupply without a check.
burn decrements the caller balance.
burn decrements totalSupply.
burn reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
burn reduces totalSupply.
_from selects the balance slot decremented in burnFrom.
_value is the unchecked operand in burnFrom.
burnFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without a check.
burnFrom decrements the spender allowance without a check.
burnFrom decrements totalSupply without a check.
burnFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
target selects the balance slot incremented by mintToken.
mintedAmount is the unchecked operand of the mint additions.
mintToken adds to balanceOf[target] without a check.
mintToken adds to totalSupply without a check.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the mintToken require.
msg.sender must equal owner for mintToken to proceed.
Constructor execution reaches the unchecked supply multiplication.
_transfer execution reaches the unchecked balance updates.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom execution reaches the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom calls _transfer after spending the allowance.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approveAndCall calls approve before invoking the spender.
approveAndCall execution reaches the untrusted external call with state already updated.
burn execution reaches the unchecked balance and supply decrements.
burnFrom execution reaches the unchecked decrements.
mintToken execution reaches the unchecked mint additions.
mintToken calls _transfer twice to route minted tokens to target.
Constructor writes the initial value of totalSupply.
The untrusted spender can re-enter approveAndCall and the token during the receiveApproval callback.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter exists only to index the balanceOf mapping inside balanceOf and collapses into that function node.
_from is consumed exclusively by the internal _transfer balance arithmetic and has no independent semantics.
_to is used only for the zero-address check and the credit in _transfer.
_value is the amount operand of the _transfer arithmetic and merges into that function.
_to is forwarded directly from transfer into _transfer and carries no extra behaviour.
_value is forwarded directly from transfer into _transfer.
_from is only an argument forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
_to is only an argument forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
_value directly drives the unchecked allowance subtraction, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
_spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
_value is only the allowance value written by approve.
_spender is cast to tokenRecipient and is the target of the untrusted external call.
_value is passed straight into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
_extraData is arbitrary calldata forwarded to the untrusted spender.
_value is the operand of the unchecked decrements in burn.
_from only selects the balance and allowance slots consumed by burnFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance, allowance and supply decrements.
target only selects the balance slot credited by mintToken.
mintedAmount is the operand of the unchecked mint additions.
initialSupply is the multiplicand of the unchecked 10**decimals supply computation.
tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable during construction.
tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable during construction.
The named return variable balance only carries the mapping value out of balanceOf.
success is a constant true return flag of transferFrom and adds no independent behaviour.
The spender interface instance exists solely to perform the untrusted receiveApproval call.
